notes.title: Native Linux and Steam Deck support!
notes.notes:
Hello, it's been a while huh.

Wally and the FANTASTIC PREDATORS now has [b]native Linux and Steam Deck support[/b].
Oh, also Steam Auto Cloud saves (set up to be cross-platform) and even Steam Input.

These changes should allow for a [b]smooth Steam Deck experience right out of the box[/b], such as savedata syncing between your main machine and your Deck and also easy control rebinding.

As for now, we don't have a "Steam Deck Verified" rating, but the Linux build has been tested to work on Ubuntu 64-Bit LTS releases.

If anything, tell your Deck to run the [b]default Linux build[/b].

To prevent any odd-looking behavior, the Linux version will always start in fullscreen if it's in Big Picture or Deck mode by default, even if you've synced savedata with your main machine.

Thank you for playing Wally!

[i](a macOS port is coming in the near future!)[/i]

notes.title: Final Update
notes.notes:
I want to tell you something.

It's 2018. I'm showing my Grandma the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CBXgYmFeSQs]FOXLION[/url] thinking I'm some kind of big shot game developer. She smiles and tells me it looks nice. I'm so freaking happy.

At the time my grandma had cancer. I didn't realize how bad it was, I probably would have used my time differently with her if I paid more attention to how bad she had it. She is my favorite person in the world and it meant the world to me to have her approval.

She never was able to see the end of Wally. I wish she did, I think she would have been proud of the true ending.

I would have really loved to have read her your comments. To see how many it resonated with so many people.

When she died I was devastated. She's gone my family tried to convince me to be more religious and to think of her in heaven and in a better place but I don't want to think that. I'm scared that if I do I'll take things for granted. (REMEMBER BOON YOUR MOM WILL DIE MAKE SURE YOU SPEND AS MUCH TIME WITH HER NOW BECAUSE YOU'LL NEVER GET THE CHANCE TO LATER)

I want to be scared knowing I can die any day and to make sure I'm using my few precious hours as efficiently as possible. I'll make sure you only get MY BEST OK! Because what if there is never another game from me ever again. Then I'll make sure I give you my best work TODAY!


No time to be fearful or scared when it comes to making a game. Be as genuine with me as possible and create whatever comes out of my heart. Follow my instincts and run with it.

This manifests into ideas such as the AAAAAAA dungeon, the black and white dungeon, the box that never gets picked, the true ending. Ideas that really just came from a whim and I run with them full speed ahead.



I'm really happy with what we've built guys. I wanted to give you context on where I was coming from with Wally and why I wanted to make this game in the first place.


It's thanks to my grandma that she made me comfortable with my best and worst parts, to find strength in vulnerability, to grow a backbone, and trust my instincts.

My grandma FREAKING ROCKED! She is amazing and I want to keep her alive in the subtext of Wally.

Wally is not a game about my grandma but it does capture her warmth, unflinching honesty, and power that I try my best to channel.




Thank you for reading. It's from the depth of my heart that I wanted to thank you for seeing this project become finished. I feel like everything that needed to be said with Wally has been said and I want gracefully say goodbye.



Thank you very much for taking the time to hang out with me for all of these years. I am grateful for your support. It's thanks to you I had an audience to keep me going through the best and worst times.


Thank you for taking the time to play Wally, to help out, and for being here for me. This Update might be the final major update for Wally.



I really don't want to type that this is the last update. It sends shivers down my spine typing this. I freaking love being able to work on it and to keep adding more and more. The main reason I want to make this final update is that I feel like I've said everything I've needed to say with Wally, I explored everything that I've wanted to explore mechanically, enemy-wise , and true ending-wise.


I'm happy with Wally.


I'm happy with What I was able to say with Wally and I'm really happy to have been able to hear your comments and reactions. It fills me with determination. In all honesty, It's thanks to you that have ignited a fire within me to keep working no matter what.


I really want to go above and beyond and deliver you the best possible thing I can do and I feel as though I've reached my goal.


Thank you for playing Wally. It's been a wonderful couple of years. I hope success fills your next year, and you reach your next goal so that you can kick life's ass and be the superstar you always were meant to be :D

As a tutorial sign once said:

LET'S FREAKING GO, DUDE!!!

Thank you very much for your continued support. I'll be working on a new roguelike exploring Ideas I've wanted to make work in Wally but I couldn't seem to make work due to the rules of the genre. If you want to help test it, just join the beta branch role in [url=https://discord.gg/wally]discord[/url].


There may be updates in the future for Wally, but I'm not planning on adding anything major for now.

[h1]HIGHLIGHT DAILY RUN REWORK[/h1]

Daily Runs have been re-added. 
Global Scores and names will be available for you to view in the main hub area.
Scores are also available in the Steam Leader boards.





Rules for Daily Runs!
So here is the deal and rules for Daily Runs!


Every Day each run will feature some crazy different twist, something to make the runs feel unique from one another.


I think Wally is funnest when you are getting lots of combos and opening as many chests as possible. 


So rules for the current scoring system.

Knocking out an enemy with less than 6 combos grants you 1 point.
Knocking out an enemy with more than 6 combos grants you 2 points.
Knocking out an enemy with more than 10 combos grants you 3 points.

So yeah try to keep a good combo and you'll start generating a score higher than anyone else.

Going through a dungeon without taking damage grants you +10 points.

Beating a boss grants you +10 points.
Beating a boss without taking damage +20 points.

[h1]Chests scoring system.[/h1]
I feel like these might be too generous for now but ehh whatever let's have some fun with this!

The 1st chest you hit grants you  +1 point.
The 2nd chest you open grants you +1 point.
The 3rd chest you open grants you +2 point.
The 4th chest you open grants you +2 point.
The 5th chest you open AND ONWARDS grants you +3 points.

notes.title: BRANCHING PATHS UPDATE
notes.notes:
[b]Patch Highlight: Branching Paths[/b]

Choose the next end level event that will occur on the next floor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35672531/f2dc88ff560227cf7020da970bb63d3c1f30bd83.png[/img]

This is why I'm adding branching paths.

 Wally is designed specifically for [b]two[/b] types of experiences. 

1. The first experience is to experience something. 

This is the feeling you get when you roll some dice, your chest tightens with anticipation and you nervously pray that the dice gods will be kind to you this evening. The dice lands on a good outcome and you burst with relief and tension. 


This dice roll can only work when someone risks something of value (for example, let's say you pay 150 dollars for a chance to win 1,000 if it lands on a 6 ). That relief can only occur because of the tension that preceded it.

I call this: Timmy.


Timmy likes things like Random Chance, things like the potion of mystery, and doubling the potency of mystery potions. Choosing the Box that Never gets picked at the end of a Boss fight that will spawn a random reward. Timmy's all about that high roller chance

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35672531/7ab97d41d7577848b055e29a790c13d6fc981aff.jpg[/img]



2. The other playstyle is like to call Chad Thundercock: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35672531/d5e1e4aaf659bd3febe29f986258b06569221a26.png[/img]

Chad knows that their mechanical skills are the best. They are more than fine taking as many curses as possible in order to become a glass cannon and play with a sliver of health. Chad doesn't like potions of Mystery that because it has too much randomness variables for Chad. Instead, they would prefer getting an upgrade that depletes your hp to 0.001 and turns you into an overpowered beast.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35672531/722f40c86bc860ab545f6bd9daf89bc111a8701c.png[/img]
(This item is a rare drop that can be found by choosing Chad's branching paths.

[url=https://youtu.be/QHHg99hwQGY?t=2624](I would highly recommend checking out this talk by Magic the Gathering head designer Mark Rosewater which is where I learned this from)[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35672531/b5972d86e3d109a307b77b2a73ebf8122bb92a22.png[/img]




So that's why in Wally there are items like Mystery potions. The bad effect is important and I know it dissuades a lot of people from it. But the mystery potion high power level only works because it really feels like you're risking SOMETHING for that high roll.

It's more important to have items that people love and hate than something that makes people feel pretty indifferent.






Next let's talk about the Chad Player.


Players who want to go immediately into their glass cannon build! Who is more than happy to make the game harder, they play for that high-risk high reward playstyles where they are fine being completely overpowered even if they die in one hit. Because they trust that their own mechanical ability will carry them.


These branching paths will allow you to choose the next level event (so you can exchange resource X for a resource Y) But if you find yourself leaning to one playstyle more than the other then you'll also be able to find shops that cater specifically to these type of playstyles.

The Chad Player is going to get two new shops for them. The Don Jon Shop and the Chad Shop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35672531/c5ecffbaa79e72f6180c35a05d66ac1d5bd0c9dd.png[/img]

The Don Jon Shop for Chad
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35672531/ee7def34ae1f873695ba00873dd893b47b6aec57.png[/img]
This shop offers 3 different courses, you can choose, none, one or all three. You will also retain any bonuses to them.

The second shop is the Chad shop where you pay with your max hp in order to get a reward that will turn you into a glass cannon.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35672531/6d6da076c34f0c30c2e97a006a9a7b796458bb03.png[/img]


For Timmy players, I created Mystery Gifts shops. They are events where you pay a hefty resource (2 hearts or huge amount of money for the chance to get something great).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35672531/b8d11581009387f7c59d11dd5b6b779f6e364ceb.png[/img]


Rather than the game's randomness giving you something you might like or not, you'll be able to choose what path and playstyle you'll prefer instead.


So thanks I hope you liked these changes! I think being upfront about the changes in Wally is one of the best things I can do with you because when you understand why things are getting changed in the background I can get better feedback from you. And if you'd like to hear more of this from me then I'd love to invite you to my [url=https://mailchi.mp/a726b5fc53c6/boon]private newsletter[/url].


____________________________________________________



Major Changes!

[b]There is no one-shot protection. You will now start with 5 max hearts instead of 3.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35672531/03670f82ff2d117f713618a69d1871085e5f24f3.png[/img]
What the heck is one-shot protection?


Well in Wally whenever you take 1 hearts of damage while you had 1/2 heart remaining. You would survive with 1/4 heart remaining. This would give you a second chance to survive. 

This is getting removed for the reason that it was too efficient at surviving as long as you found even a sliver of health later. Having this safety net fought against the idea of having a glass cannon build, where you would be at your strongest but making fewer mistakes would end up killing you.


So this mechanic is getting removed but you are getting +2 hearts to compensate.


________________________________________________________


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35672531/c18a17812f999b4c53ccf5539f4c8610965940d1.png[/img]

[b]Blue gems have been reworked.[/b] Now whenever you pick one up you will get a random amount of Money  (50, 100, 150, 500, 1000). That's it.

This is done because I noticed that some upgrades from the blue gems appeared far too often. (Such as Stamina buddy) This is in conflict with Wally's goal of having a different run each time. Having one upgrade appear too consistently between runs makes very samey runs which is why this had to go.

There are now more ways to spend money with the different shops so having more money coming in will go a long way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35672531/96e57dec629b86cb99aa47bbfc9181c69ebe6c16.png[/img]

This will make it much easier to reach chests farther away!


You now have a starting limit of 9 bombs so remember to use them. 


Additionally, this buff is also affected by [b]POTIONS OF MYSTERY [/b] wall radius explosion. 

_________________________________________________________


[b]Rolling now Costs  from 2 -> 4 stamina.[/b]
[b]Sword now Costs  from 2 -> 4 stamina.[/b]
[b]Stamina recharge rate increased fom 0.85 -> 1 SEC[/b]
[b]You can no longer regain stamina from killing enemies[/b]


Don't panic I know that it looks like I lost my mind but I'll explain why this change is going to make a better game.



Even though it is very nice to spam roll when you're in a dangerous situation, it became too reliable as an option to avoid bullets. It's a get out of jail free card that can be applied to any situation.



This undermined the funniest thing about bullet hells which was to find patterns that you can weave in and around through bullets. Not having a roll dodge causes you to use the level generation to your advantage, to find nooks and crannies that you can hide, which gave you a better reason to use the level generator.

This is going to make the game slower in the beginning and I think that's a fine tradeoff due to the amount of depth that we will get for this.


Over longer and more runs this ended up making for a much better experience.


The game has been made easier, in the beginning, to compensate for this change. (We'll get to this later)



Due to your stamina always being full the stamina upgrade options were not as attractive due to how consistently you recovered stamina. So having an option where you could recharge stamina after destroying a box seemed like a no brainer to go with the more damage option.

By having less stamina at the start, fixing your stamina problems became a priority. Which made harder decisions from having to choose between a stamina upgrade or a different upgrade.

I will not be making these changes to the sword the only mode, in fact, that mode is going to stay true to the Instant gratification nature of the 2019 version of Wally, that version of the game will remain in a glass box untouched so that the purists who enjoyed the original modes will still be able to try it out.

notes.title: NEW RUNS
notes.notes:
I'm very happy to announce two runs have been added!


Isaiah run and the Sword Only run.


Sword only runs grabs everything that makes Wally unique and gets rid of everything else. It's a very fast hacky and slashy game and the ONLY mode where you can use the sword by rolling into them. It's a mode that is made for someone who has nothing to prove and just wants to unwind after a long day.

Isaiah's run is inspired by Isaac. No roll dodge, you can only shoot in 4 directions. It's catered for the tryhard rogue-lite fans.


Why I decided to add Isaiah and the Sword Only mode modes.

At its core, Roguelites are delivering a power fantasy. You start out weak, trying your best to find the tools needed to create an unstoppable build. The stronger you are at the beginning the harder it is to create the feeling of growth.

When I set out to make Wally I had NO idea what I was doing. I just wanted to make a game that felt fun to play, which is what the boomerang/sword run is about.

As a result, Sword Run is a hack and slash first with light Roguelite elements second. It plays better to the feeling of speed that makes Wally unique.

Next, I want to the exact opposite, what if we went through the deep end on the other side, we made a traditional rogue-lite! Went really ham, made you weak as heck in the beginning so that by the end you'll be an unstoppable glass cannon. The underlying reason why we play roguelike/lites! 

This is what Isaiah mode is about.

notes.title: THE FOXLION RETURNS
notes.notes:
Hello beautiful people it's me BOON, excited as heck to write the biggest update for Wally and the FANTASTIC PREDATORS to date! 


I disappeared for months in order to learn, create, and implement in Wally one of the most gorgeous lighting systems ever. They are dynamic highlights that are created through any light source in Wally.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35672531/23e3bad7e0f7e7c1dcccd74ce594661803d91945.png[/img]


[url=https://gfycat.com/conventionalregalcowbird](You can see how the potion of mystery illuminates the surrounding area as well as your bullets)[/url]

To make this lighting system work without setting our PC on fire our we had to completely re-write foundational code for Wally which is where most of the time went.

Now the actual patch itself!

[b]Major Change: Dungeon Events.[/b]

What are they?
After completing a floor a character or object will spawn on the floor. Events can modify rules for your run, Spawn a friendly shop where you can spend money, hearts, or other resources. Offer challenges that will make the game harder but reward you with more loot. Or help you out if you're in an emergency.

Some events will spawn randomly and others need certain conditions to be met.

List of all the events:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35672531/a725daed030b9c28ca0b552a572c34f0f1cb7c98.png[/img]
[list]
[*] 1. Chad 
Chad is the greatest gamer who has ever existed. He only shows up in the first floor if you are successful in not taking a single point of damage. Chad recognizes talent when he sees it and offers you a nostalgic trip back to 2019, back when the game first came out and the difficulty was tough as nails. Partaking in Chad's challenge will give you early access sword as well as being able to choose 3 upgrades after killing the Foxlion 2 floors down.
[*] 2. X marks the Spot
 There is cursed treasure hidden underneath the X. But digging for it too much will trigger the curse which will evaporate all the money that you've found. Every time you dig you increase the likelyhood for the curse to trigger 4+ of the time so the first time you dig you'll get money 100% then 98% then 96% then 94% ... You'll uncover even more treasure the deeper you go how many digs can you go before you stop yourself or the curse gets you!

[*] 3. Jimmy (The World's Greatest Nurse)
 Jimmy is my IRL friend, he is the nicest person I've ever met. I sent him a text and told him to show up in your run if you are at 1/4 of a heart remaining. He totally agreed but he only gets one 5 minute break per day so he can only show up one time per run.

Now you might be asking: BOON why is your real-life friend Jimmy being included in Wally, did he bribe is way in? Does he have compromising photos of you? Well to that I say heck no! Jimmy is a trained medical professional and the best nurse there is. I am trusting your lives in the hands of the best Nurse in the world. I am certain that with Jimmy at your side you'll be able to go even further in your runs than ever before!

[*] 4. Bomb Shop
This shop only accepts hearts as payments, the economy is in shambles and hugs are the only currency that matters anyways.

[*] 5. BackPack Guy
Backpack guy will have a 35% of showing up if you have over 400 money on you. I heard that players were not too happy having him show up when they had no money to spend.

[*] 6. Sad Backpack guy
 This time it's the huggable variant of backpack guy. He has been modified so that now he has a 60% of giving you loot rather than 40% on the previous patch, now there is a chance he can give you bombs to break upon walls.
 
[*] 7. Salmon Sally
[*] Sally has collected everything that is worth getting in the ocean, and now is looking for things to collect in a dry land. She will trade you a weapon for something on you, such as a bomb, curse skips, or cash.

[*] 8. Slot machines may spawn asking for health or cash for payment in exchange for treasure.

[*] 9. 10. 11: Telly
 I ran out of money and skills for pixel art so Telly the television will have to carry and do the jobs of three npcs! (don't worry having three jobs to earn a living is normal where I live) Until we can find someone to cover for them here is Telly.
[*] 9. Bomb shop Telly
Telly will give you 10 bombs in exchange for removing the 04% of finding bombs in crates.

[*] 10. Make the bosses tougher
Telly will give you a ton of cash but now the next boss will now start on their second phase.

[*] 11. No rolling
Telly will give you a random fantastic reward but now you can't roll until starting the next boss fight. But in order to keep the pacing of the game fast, we will allow rolling after you complete a level.
[/list]

[b]Balance Changes[/b]
[b]Your default gun range now has unlimited ammo.[/b]
[i]This is to prevent you from running out of ammo if you choose to do the whole run with just the default weapon you can without fear of having it replaced.[/i]


Weapons have been removed from chests and upgrades. They will only show up as a potential boss reward / special dungeon event/ or as an upgrade.

[i]The reason behind this change is that I started noticing that when you saw EVERY gun in each run just in a different order the runs started to feel pretty similar killing the vibe of the roguelite. Seeing fewer weapons each run BUT now you can keep improving the weapon you find will create for a more diverse experience.[/i]


Enemy warnings are much larger and visible to see.

Your starting weapon has a much lower range now. You will now have to get much closer to the enemy line of fire to do damage at the beginning of runs.

You do not start with the sword. Instead, you will have access to it after defeating the Foxlion or Starting Chad's challenge.

[i]This upgrade was really boring I mean COME ON +10 lightning range!? We can do way better than that.

Today's patch combines boomerang, longsword, and bullet run into a new game mode called [b]BETA DUNGEON[/b]. To start a beta dungeon, just start a game with bullet run by hitting dungeon block so it says BETA DUNGEON. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35672531/dd3ad00da9cc4e2875e51a9418ea2f7b70c13b85.png[/img]

Here is how I came with this decision to rework Bullet mode. 

According to a lot of feedback the longsword was the funnest way to play Wally.  The long sword, it's fast instant and allows you for aggressive and defensive options. For this reason [b]I'm enabling longsword in the BETA DUNGEON[/b]. One thing I really want to add is diversity in playstyle to the max. In order to keep the pacing of the game fast I buffed all weapons so that their damage matches the speed of the boomerang or that of the sword run additionally you will now see the boomerang alongside that of the other buffed weapons who will be able to even outperform the boomerang and sword on the right enemies.

[olist]

Deals 3 damage per shot, has max range.

notes.title: LOOPING UPDATE
notes.notes:
When you finish a run you will anger Don Jon so much that he will start cheating. He will start removing features that were designed to save you. He will send you back to the first dungeon and you'll start a LOOP. Everything has increased in difficulty and taking damage with enough loops may result in instant death.

When a Loop starts all bullets/fireballs will speed up by 10%.
Enemies wake up twice as fast.
All damage will deal half a heart more.

While in a loop you will not be able to survive damage that will kill you with 1/4 Heart remaining. You will just die.

Stamina cost for the ROLL  will be increased from 2 to 3 on your first loop(but it will not exceed 3 even after doing multiple loops).
[b][i]The theme of a loop is that mistakes will be a lot more punishing than before. A miss-used roll will result in a finished run.[/i][/b]

Downgrade options will always be 1 when you are in a loop.

CLOAK and MANTA Ray HP Now scale-up in LOOPS.

Cloak's difficulty scales with each loop.
Mini-Manta ray's fireball speed increases based on your current loop.




[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
Fixed a bug that would cause your boomerang to move so fast it was impossible to catch.
FIXED DRAGONS NOT BEING ABLE TO ATTACK WHILE THEY WERE ONSCREEN
FIXED STAMINA BUDDY NOT ABLE TO HIT MANTA RAYS
FIXED SWORD FIREBALL NOT HITTING THE MANTA RAYS
FIXED a glitch that caused you to start a loop on the JUMP State! You will now start in the ROLL STATE.
FIXED a glitch that caused the boomerang to move so fast that it was uncatchable.
Fixed a bug that caused the dragons to not attack while they were on screen.



[b]GAMEPLAY CHANGES[/b]
Dragon boss: Lowered second phase fireball speed from 1.8 to 1.6
[i]This will make it easier to dodge the fireballs considering they ricochet.[/i]

Experience needed for next level up formula has been reworked.
New EXP formula
[b]EXP_NEEDED= round(5 * ((CURRENT_LEVEL+2)^4) / 5);[/b]

[b]Added a minimalistic HUD option. Enable it by pressing F1 once[/b]

[b]UPGRADE CHANGES[/b]
+1 Heart has been changed to 1/2 heart on level ups

ADDED half heart to the shop.

[i][b]When the above upgrades combined players would be able to abuse the invincibility frames fo rolling and skip entire levels. These upgrades will be removed until further notice.[/b][/i]

[i][b]This particular upgrade was meant to help out new players take on boss fights, so a price reduction will help it be picked more for a player that might need it. But it will also not be able to be abused to consistently refuel your HP for multiple boss fights.[/b][/i]
